🏥 Revive Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation Center ✨

Experience advanced physiotherapy and holistic rehabilitation at Revive, Hyderabad’s trusted center for recovery.

Led by Dr. Srikanth Babu Katari (MPT), a senior physiotherapist with 20+ years of expertise in neuro, orthopedic, and pain rehabilitation, Revive offers personalized one-on-one care with proven results. His leadership has shaped Revive into a center of excellence.

We specialize in:
✅ Stroke & Spinal Cord Injury Rehab
✅ Neuro & Orthopedic Rehabilitation
✅ Gait Training & Cerebral Palsy Therapy
✅ Pain Management & Recovery Programs

📍 KPHB, Hyderabad
📞 +91 9885982698
🌐 reviverehabphysiotherapy.com
